statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-85396 affects rubyzip 1.3.0 in the 9.4 and 9.5 logstash lines, which resolve rubyzip 1.3.0 through the upstream logstash JRuby dependency set. The fix is only in the rubyzip 3.x major line (first fixed release 3.4.0), which changes the public API. Moving it is an upstream logstash dependency decision; overriding a single gem at the image definition level is not a safe substitute. The 8.19 line already ships rubyzip 3.6.0, so it is not affected.

CVE-2026-85396 affects rubyzip 1.3.0 in the 9.4 and 9.5 logstash lines, which resolve rubyzip 1.3.0 through the upstream logstash JRuby dependency set. The fix is only in the rubyzip 3.x major line (first fixed release 3.4.0), which changes the public API. Moving it is an upstream logstash dependency decision; overriding a single gem at the image definition level is not a safe substitute. The 8.19 line already ships rubyzip 3.6.0, so it is not affected.

The fix requires rubyzip 3.4.0, a major release; there is no 2.x backport (2.4.1 is the last 2.x). GitLab pins rubyzip ~> 2.4.0 on the 18 and 19 lines and still on master; upstream's own update to v3 (gitlab-org/gitlab!254860) failed its pipelines and was closed unmerged on 2026-09-30, so the bump cannot be carried here without diverging from GitLab.
